name: Particle Wand
description:
Can be used to create particle effects in the world.
Left Click: Increase planned particle field radius
Sneak + Left Click: Decrease planned particle field radius
Right Click: Cycle through various available particles
Sneak + Right Click: Confirm field creation
Current Radius: Displays current particle field radius
Current Particle: Displays your currently selected particle

Using on an entity attaches the field to that entity.
Placed fields can be recollected by using a stick on them.
